decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The extension shall be built in facing brick to match the front elevation of the house and the roof tiles shall match those existing on the main roof of the house at the time of submission of this application.

Condition : 4 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The extension hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 16 Albury Avenue.

Condition : 6 - Notwithstanding the design shown on the approved drawings, the existing front porch roof, shall be retained or be reconstructed to match the existing roof in accordance with the note on the submitted plans.
description: Erection of single storey front extension to the existing garage and a first floor side extension and insertion of two roof lights in the rear roof slope and one in the front roof slope
